messages.text: Hey a quick question if I would order the Thor p2 will the shipping be from a location in Europe. The reason why I’m asking is because if you ship the item from elsewhere I have to pay an additional tax fee and I would like to avoid that
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page

No, I can't promise an EU-warehouse dispatch on the Thor P2. It's the single "US / EU (matched to your address)" variant, so it goes out from our US side and 21% import VAT plus any duty is charged on delivery by the carrier or customs. We don't collect it at checkout and can't quote the exact figure your customs office raises.

It's $369 right now, down from $449, and the ship window is October 3. Which country are you in? If it's the Netherlands I'll check that one separately.

Then it's the import-VAT case, Rolf... sorry, no name yet. Germany: the listed $369 is the unit price, 21% import VAT is charged on delivery by the carrier or customs, and any duty is yours. Shipping itself is calculated at checkout from your address, so add those two separately.

Your plug is fine either way, the P2 is matched to your address and comes with an EU cable.

Want me to check which units we hold in the EU warehouse? Those ship VAT-included, nothing payable on delivery.
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04 bitcoin miner

I checked. Right now the only listings with their own EU stock line are the NerdQaxe++, and its EU variant is out of stock, and the Hammer DC02 at $239.99, which is a Doge/Litecoin miner, not Bitcoin.

Every Bitcoin miner we sell, the P2 included, is the address-matched variant, so the 21% import VAT applies on delivery. There's no way around it on the P2.

Is Bitcoin what you want to mine, or would Doge/Litecoin work for you?
No only the one and only Btc

Then VAT is just part of the price, and it's the same 21% whatever you buy. So the thing to optimise is cost per terahash.

Thor P2: $369 for 10 TH/s, about $37 per TH, ships October 3.
Magic Miner 40T: $799 for 40 TH/s, about $20 per TH, Batch 5 ships November 14.
Harlo B30: $899 for 30 TH/s, ships October 30.

The 40T is by far the best value we sell. Want me to run the sats and power numbers for Germany?
I prefer the 1373 chip therefore the p2 Thor

Fair enough. Worth knowing the Harlo B30 runs the same BM1373 chips, 30 TH/s for $899, about $30 per TH, ships October 30. Same chip family, three times the hashrate.

If you'd rather stay with the P2, it's $369, down from $449, ships October 3, EU cable included.

Say the word and I'll build the cart with a checkout link. One P2, or do you want the B30 quote too?
How about the power consumption compared to the hash rate ?

From the spec sheets: the P2 is 10 TH/s at ~166 W, so about 17 J/TH. The B30 is 30 TH/s at 360 to 450 W, so 12 to 15 J/TH, the most efficient of the three. The Magic Miner 40T sits at ~16 J/TH, 650 W at 40 TH/s.

So the B30 does three times the work of the P2 for roughly the same efficiency, slightly better. The P2's advantage is the small 166 W draw and 40 dB noise.
